message: Oh my gosh.  When I read this it was like reading my story about t-netix.  I too received the same treatment.  My husband is there and I have received his calls everynight.  Then all of a sudden, I have a block on my phone.  It took me over two weeks of telephone hell to find out what was wrong.  I kept thinking they were saying connectics.  I couldn't understand what they were saying because you couldn't understand. Now, I am only 51 and have good hearing.  I finally found out they were saying t-netix.  They I find out they put a limit on my phone.  With AT&T I too had a correction plan, changed, no warning not told a single thing.  I just couldn't talk to my husband.  My phone bill with AT&T was 200-250 a month and always paid on time.  t-netix put a $75 limit on my phone then blocked all of my calls.  I am sorry but this has got to be the worst of the worst of phone companies.  This is definately the phone company from hell.
